name: Da Nang
provinceNote: Da Nang city now includes the former Quang Nam province, so Hoi An and My Son sit inside it.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Sleep on My Khe when you want the sea at the end of the bed and a beachfront resort on the sand. The beach runs for kilometers, the morning is the water, and An Thuong, a few streets inland, is the night of bars and kitchens. Kalà Kalà is the club on the sand and East West is the brewery facing the water. Sleep in Hoi An when the old town after dark is the reason you came. The two are under an hour apart.
timeNeeded: 1–2 days, plus nights if you prefer a beach hotel to Hoi An
fee: No single city ticket. The beach is free.
getThere: Da Nang International Airport (DAD) is a short ride from the river. Hoi An is about 30 minutes on from the Marble Mountains.
seoTitle: Da Nang travel guide — My Khe beach and An Thuong
seoDescription: Sleep on My Khe for the beach and a beachfront resort. An Thuong, just inland, is the night. Hoi An is under an hour when the old town is the point.
intro: Start on the sand. My Khe is a long city beach with the resort towers on the water and the surf as the morning. The swim is free. The city’s English page calls January to July the dry season, so that is the window for a beach week. Go in only when the flags say the water is open. Chair hire is check on arrival.

The night is a short walk inland, on the streets just west of the sand. An Thuong is that grid: bars and kitchens close enough to wander between, which is why a beach hotel works after dark and a river hotel does not. On the sand itself, Kalà Kalà Beach Club at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap is open daily and entry is free. Its own site lists both midnight and 02:00 as closing, so confirm the night you go. East West Brewing’s beachfront taproom, on My Khe, pours from 08:00 to 01:00.

Give a morning to the Cham Museum, on the Han River, when you want the stone before the swim. A general ticket is 60,000 VND and an hour is enough. The sculpture comes from My Son and the other Cham sites. The galleries are not the ruins. The door time is published as both 07:00 and 07:30, and both say it closes at 17:00, so confirm that morning. The Marble Mountains are about 15 minutes out, on the road you already take toward Hoi An. Climb Thuy Son. That hill is 40,000 VND.

Son Tra is the view that is not a theme park. The Quan The Am at Linh Ung is 67 meters and faces the sea, and the peninsula ride is half a day. No entry fee is published. Dragon Bridge is the weekend picture from the river path: fire and water at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, not on an ordinary weeknight. Hai Van, north toward Hue, is a clear-weather detour. The train to Hue is about three hours if you would rather not drive the pass.
gettingAround: The airport is about 10–15 minutes from the center by car. Grab is the easy way across town. Sleep on My Khe if the beach is the trip: An Thuong is a walk inland, and the river is a ride. Sleep on the Han if you want the museum and Dragon Bridge on foot, and treat the beach as the outing. The Marble Mountains are about 15 minutes out, and Hoi An is about 30 minutes further by the coastal road. North–south trains stop at Ga Da Nang.

stayAreas.name: My Khe beach
stayAreas.summary: Sleep in a beachfront resort if the sea is why you picked the city. You wake up on My Khe. An Thuong’s bars and kitchens are a few streets inland, and the beach night is Kalà Kalà and East West.

stayAreas.name: Han River
stayAreas.summary: Sleep here if you want the museum, Dragon Bridge, and dinner on foot. The beach becomes a ride. That is a fair trade for a city morning, and a poor one if An Thuong after dark is the point.

eat: Lunch is mi Quang. Breakfast, if you are in the city, is bun cha ca. Dinner on My Khe is seafood, and the drinks are on the sand and in An Thuong. The full menu is on the food guide.
interestsBody: My Khe is the morning swim, in the drier months, with the resort front on the sand.
An Thuong is the night, a few streets inland: bars and kitchens you can walk between. On the sand, Kalà Kalà is the beach club and East West is the brewery facing the water.
The Cham Museum is the cultural hour on the river, before you give the day to the beach. It is not a stand-in for My Son.
Dragon Bridge breathes fire on weekend nights. For lanterns and cao lau, ride to Hoi An.

season.label: Drier beach months
season.note: The city’s English page calls January to July dry and August to December wet, with the heaviest rain in October and November. The Vietnamese page calls January to September dry and puts floods in September to November. Treat September as unsettled, and check the Hoi An road and Hai Van on the morning you go.

faqs.q: Should you stay in Da Nang or Hoi An?
faqs.a: Sleep in Da Nang if you want a beach morning, a resort on the sand, and An Thuong after dark. Sleep in Hoi An if the old town at night is the reason you came. See the other city as a ride, not as a second hotel move in the same day.

A few streets inland from My Khe, in An Thuong, and on the sand itself. Kalà Kalà Beach Club is at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap, and entry is free. East West Brewing’s beachfront taproom is open 08:00 to 01:00. Dragon Bridge is the other evening, at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.

faqs.q: When does Dragon Bridge breathe fire?
faqs.a: At 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, and on major holidays. It is not a weeknight show. During the fireworks festival the night can move, so check that week.
